tools.name: bol_list_orders
tools.description: List the seller's bol orders (50 per page), each with its order items, EANs, quantities, prices, fulfilment method and the buyer's shipment details (personal data). By default only OPEN orders fulfilled by the retailer (FBR). Use change_interval_minute or latest_change_date to poll for recent change

tools.name: bol_get_order
tools.description: One order by id: the order items (with their order item ids), prices, quantities, fulfilment, the buyer's shipment and billing details (personal data) and the latest delivery dates. GET /retailer/orders/{order-id}.

tools.name: bol_list_shipments
tools.description: List shipments up to 3 months old, newest first (50 per page): shipment id, date, the order items shipped and the transport (track and trace). Filter by order_id OR fulfilment_method (order_id wins). GET /retailer/shipments.

tools.name: bol_get_shipment
tools.description: One shipment by id: shipment date, order items, transport and track and trace details, the buyer's delivery address (personal data). GET /retailer/shipments/{shipment-id}.

tools.name: bol_list_returns
tools.description: List customer returns (RMA): return id, registration date, fulfilment method and the return items with their handling status. Set handled explicitly: true = handled returns (newest first), false = returns still to handle (oldest first); bol documents no default. GET /retailer/returns.

tools.name: bol_get_return
tools.description: One return by id: return items, reasons, handling results, the customer's details (personal data). GET /retailer/returns/{return-id}.

tools.name: bol_list_offers
tools.description: List the seller's offers (Offers API v11): offer id, EAN, condition, price bundles, stock, fulfilment, on-hold flag and last-modified time. Filter by offer ids, EANs, your reference, for-sale state or last-modified time. Cursor paging: pass the previous reply's next_cursor. GET /retailer/offers (v11

tools.name: bol_get_offer
tools.description: One offer by id (Offers API v11): condition, price bundles, stock, fulfilment, countries, product. GET /retailer/offers/{offer-id} (v11).

tools.name: bol_get_offer_not_for_sale_reasons
tools.description: The reasons an offer is not for sale per country (an offer that is for sale everywhere has none) (content, price, stock, shop status, selling rights, on hold, assortment policy), each with a code and description. GET /retailer/offers/{offer-id}/not-for-sale-reasons (v11).

tools.name: bol_update_offer
tools.description: WRITE: change an existing offer on bol (Offers API v11 PATCH): put it on hold or back on sale, set your reference, replace its price bundles and/or its own stock. Only the fields you pass change. A price or stock change goes live on bol.com. Use bol_list_offers first to see the current values. PATCH

tools.name: bol_list_inventory
tools.description: Fulfilment by bol (FBB/LVB) inventory only, not your own stock (50 per page): EAN, title, regular and graded stock, and the stock level. Filter by EAN or title, stock level, stock type or a quantity range. GET /retailer/inventory.

tools.name: bol_list_invoices
tools.description: List bol invoices (the seller's statements from bol), by default the past 4 weeks: invoice id, issue date, type, period and the media types it can be downloaded in. Pass both dates to look further back (max 31 days). GET /retailer/invoices.

tools.name: bol_get_invoice_specification
tools.description: The transactions (sales, commissions, shipping, returns) behind one bol invoice, as JSON, up to 25,000 lines per page. GET /retailer/invoices/{invoice-id}/specification.

tools.name: bol_get_commissions
tools.description: Calculate bol's commission for up to 100 products: for each EAN, a selling price and optionally a condition, returns the fixed amount, the percentage, total cost and any reductions. Read-only (a POST because of the request body). POST /retailer/commission.

tools.name: bol_get_competing_offers
tools.description: The offers on bol.com for one EAN from all retailers: price, condition, fulfilment, the best offer. Optionally only the best offer or one condition and country. GET /retailer/products/{ean}/offers.

tools.name: bol_get_performance_indicator
tools.description: The seller's weekly measurements of one bol performance indicator (cancellations, fulfilment, phone availability, response time, case/item ratio, track and trace, returns, reviews) for an ISO year and week. GET /retailer/insights/performance/indicator.

tools.name: bol_get_sales_forecast
tools.description: bol's sales forecast for one offer: expected sales on the whole bol.com platform for the next 1-12 weeks. GET /retailer/insights/sales-forecast.

tools.name: bol_get_process_status
tools.description: The status of an asynchronous bol process (a write that answered 202) by its process status id: PENDING, SUCCESS, FAILURE or TIMEOUT, with the error message on failure. GET /shared/process-status/{process-status-id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bol_list_invoices, bol_get_commissions, bol_get_performance_indicator, bol_get_process_status · Private data: bol_list_returns · Public sink: bol_get_commissions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bol_list_invoices, bol_get_commissions, bol_get_performance_indicator, bol_get_process_status · Private data: bol_list_returns · Public sink: bol_get_commissions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
